text:
talia: quick heads-up — since ~02:10 PST we're seeing a spike of 500s on the onboarding webhook batch job for a segment of trial tenants. noticed delayed record ingestion and some duplicate retries. need customer comms + mitigation plan.
ben (eng): investigating now. root cause looks like a race in the batch writer when a downstream queue is throttled. rolling a fix to avoid duplicate re-enqueueing, ETA ~15m. will post rollback if anything regresses.
deploy-bot: new rollout started by ben — patch/batch-writer-fix v1.2.3 (canary -> 25%).
omar (cs): thanks. i'll draft a short note for affected customers: status + temporary workaround + offer for a live troubleshooting session. will share sample copy here.
sophie (revops): we should pre-calc prorated credit formula for affected trial tenants and flag any early renewals. suggest using 10% of monthly commit for multi-day impacts, 1% per hour otherwise.
amanda (acct exec): flagging three mid-market trials that are renewal-risked if we don't proactively reach out: Acme, Brightlane, ModuHealth. please queue prioritized outreach for those.
ben (eng): patch is at 50% canary, error rate down ~80% for affected hosts. full rollout in progress. quick mitigation for customers if they see duplicates: increase idempotency window on webhook consumer or run dedupe pass against recent batch IDs. sample command:
```bash
# dedupe by batch_id using redis set
redis-cli --eval "SREM recent_batches \"$BATCH_ID\""
```
kevin (cs): for customer-facing message i propose: 1) brief apology + root cause summary 2) confirmed mitigation steps we did 3) recommended config to avoid duplicates 4) offer a 30-min troubleshooting + onboarding healthcheck (free) 5) credit pledge and link to feedback form. i'll draft copy.
omar (cs): draft message below — short and to the point: "Hi — we detected elevated errors impacting onboarding for a subset of trial tenants between 02:10–02:45 PST. We've deployed a fix; ingestion is back to normal for most customers. If you saw duplicate deliveries, run the dedupe command or ping us and we'll run it for you. We're offering a free 30-minute troubleshooting session and a credit to affected accounts. Reply with a good time and we'll set it up." thoughts?
sophie (revops): tidy. add a single-line about credit next steps: "we'll follow up with a credit confirmation and amount within 48 hours." keeps expectations set.
amanda (acct exec): please make sure the outreach for Acme, Brightlane, ModuHealth is prioritized and include me on the first email threads. i'll offer the SE pairing for the workshop.
ben (eng): rollout complete. error rate back to baseline. pushing postmortem notes to the incident board; i can extract a short RC A paragraph for the customer email.
talia: thanks team — plan: 1) omar to send segmented outreach within 1 hour with kevin's final copy 2) revops to calculate credits and send confirmations within 48h 3) amanda to coordinate SE pairing for flagged renewals 4) we'll capture feedback with a 1-question form: did remediation meet your needs? link will be included. please add any blockers now.
kevin (cs): copy for outreach (final): "Hello — we want to let you know we identified and resolved an issue that affected onboarding deliveries for some trial accounts this morning. We're sorry for the disruption. We've deployed a fix and validated normalized ingestion across regions. If you observed duplicates or delays, we can help dedupe your recent batches and will offer a complimentary 30‑minute troubleshooting & onboarding healthcheck. We'll follow up with a credit confirmation within 48 hours. Reply to this thread or book time here: <cal.link/sixty-min>". approve? :thumbsup: or :eyes:
omar (cs): :thumbsup: sending now to segmented list (trial-tier A+B). adding amanda and kevin on high-touch threads.
sophie (revops): calc job queued for credits — using logs to compute impacted units. will post a spreadsheet link when ready.
amanda (acct exec): ping me once the high-touch emails go out. i'll draft renewal-safe language to avoid spooking them.
ben (eng): adding small excerpt for the RCA to include in the customer follow-up: "cause: throttled downstream queue exposed a race in batch writer; fix: add safe enqueue guard and better backpressure handling; mitigation: immediate rollback of duplicate writes and dedupe tooling run for affected tenants."
talia: perfect. i'll centralize thread and send exec summary after outreach completes. kevin, omar, sophie, please DM me if you need additional templates or a shared list export. closing loop once all credits confirmed.
deploy-bot: incident resolved — patch/batch-writer-fix v1.2.3 fully rolled out.
